articles.title: Here is how Coinbase plan to survive the crypto downturn by ditching its reliance on trading fees
articles.snippet: Analysts say the exchange's push into derivatives, payments and infrastructure broadens its growth story beyond crypto trading.

articles.title: Bitcoin layer-2s face a bear-market reality check
articles.snippet: Botanix's shutdown has raised an uncomfortable question for Bitcoin builders: Does the market actually want programmable BTC, or just a better way to borrow, lend and earn yield on it?

articles.title: FIFA wanted Avalanche's blockchain to help curb World Cup ticket scalping. Here's how it's going
articles.snippet: In this week's edition of The Protocol Newsletter, we're looking at how FIFA is using the Avalanche blockchain to test out a new ticketing system.

articles.title: Crypto industry aghast at Illinois' new tax on holding or transferring digital assets in state budget
articles.snippet: The 0.2% tax on any business activity involving digital assets was added last-minute, and is unlikely to change, two people familiar with the matter said.

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: The measure of a maturing market
articles.snippet: In this week's Crypto Long & Short, trusted indexes turn fragmented digital assets into a mature market that big institutions can confidently invest in, writes Kirsten Wegner. Then, the division between traditional finance (TradFi) and crypto is disappearing, says Dave LaValle, President of CoinDesk Data & Indices.
